the ministry of altar server. we invite all parents to talk with their children about becoming altar servers in our churches. full training will be provided for boys and girls from 3rd class upwards. it is a joy to see our young people taking part in our masses and liturgies. if your child is interested, please contact fr charlie directly. the ministry of welcome in our churches. the ministry of welcome plays an important role in our churches, offering a warm welcome and friendship to parishioners and everyone attending mass. if you would like to help, please contact fr charlie or a member of the parish pastoral council. baptisms in our family of parishes our lady crowned church 1st sunday of every month at 1.00pm 3rd saturday of every month at 3.00pm. st joseph’s church – mayfield 3rd saturday of every month at 4.00pm baptism preparation meetings with families saturday 14th november at 12 noon saturday 12th december at 12 noon at our lady crowned church all parents presenting a child for baptism are asked to attend a baptism preparation meeting. before booking a baptism, please make sure you can attend a preparation session beforehand. if you are unable to attend, the baptism cannot take place. st joseph’s church ~ mayfield adoration: adoration of the blessed sacrament at st. joseph's - mayfield from 10.45am to 5.00pm each day on mondays and tuesdays. new adorers invited. rosary: rosary at 5.30pm every saturday before the 6.00pm mass. all are welcome. legion of mary: every monday 7.30pm. confessions: every friday after the 10.15am mass our lady crowned church ~ mayfield christian meditation: every tuesday after the 9.30am mass. rosary: each morning at 9.00am legion of mary: every tuesday after the 9.30am mass. confessions: every friday after the 9.30am mass our lady crowned church choir christmas concert friday 11th december 2026 at 7.00pm mayfield gramophone society next meeting in the association rooms next door to mayfield library at 11am on weds 28/10/26 presented by kieran o’keeffe. all are welcome. don’t forget clocks go back 1 hour this saturday night
